question: What is said about the supreme Shiva principle beyond all measure?
premises: Beyond the measured sequence is the pure, supreme Shiva principle.
From water onward up to the Shiva principle, none but Shiva has seen it.
inference: Therefore the supreme Shiva principle transcends the measurable path and is fully known only by Shiva.
uncertainties: The scope of what is not seen by anyone but Shiva is stated broadly and may include the whole range.
plain_english: Beyond all that is the pure, supreme, immeasurable Shiva principle; from water onward up to that principle, no one but Shiva has truly seen it.
